evidence: Actual Go DownloadService and Manager with a synthetic narrow DownloadTargetClient, opaque SDK references, and isolated real filesystem saves; no external network, accounts, media or native encoder. Expected fields are generated only by PIXIV_UPDATE_STATIC_DOWNLOAD_FIXTURE=1. Static kind inputs use public ArtworkKindIllustration (illustration), not the upstream wire type illust. Provenance correction: the original synthetic wire-kind input illust was corrected to public illustration, and expectations were regenerated by actual Go; original SHA256 9ae16cb693ab8ce52ef03355e3b1bcd61844c097fff450e8954d3ca044f01474 is retained outside the repository. Unknown uses public unknown plus RawKind synthetic_new_kind. Leading-dot/trailing-dot/plain basename publication and leading-dot URL-suffix fallback cases are appended by actual Go execution after an independent Rust publication review.
normalizations: Temporary download root replaced by ${ROOT}; path separators rendered as slash
Fixture cases use GOMAXPROCS=1 for reproducible metadata/save trace; separate synchronized Go test covers reversed worker completion

Existing corrected-target os.Link error is normalized via errors.As(*os.LinkError) and errors.Is(os.ErrExist) to publish detected image extension: destination exists; no other native error wording normalized
File bytes encoded as lowercase hex; directory manifest sorted by filepath.WalkDir; timestamps, modes and diagnostics duration excluded
deferred: Real SDK metadata/resource HTTP request and cache resolution reuse existing SDK contracts; this fixture observes the manager narrow port and exact opaque variant identity
Ugoira remains accepted by Go and dispatched to its separate workflow; no fabricated Go unimplemented failure
Native Windows/macOS hard-link/filesystem permissions and injected old-path removal failure are not exercised
Account lease, CLI/MCP wire and replay behavior are covered by their separate fixtures
Page grammar parsing reuses TestParsePageSpec and TestDownloadRejectsUnboundedPageRange; fixture covers selected normalized pages

Original open-string Go custom-producer Kind illust is distinct from canonical SDK illustration; Rust ArtworkKind enum cannot represent arbitrary public Kind strings. That representational gap remains unverified rather than treating upstream RawKind as report Type.

Rust bounded worker count uses std::thread::available_parallelism; Go uses runtime.GOMAXPROCS, including explicit runtime overrides. Native/runtime worker-count equivalence across platforms and overrides is not asserted.
Native paths containing invalid Unicode are not covered by the Rust filename to_str boundary; these string-based temporary sinks do not establish non-UTF8 filesystem parity.
